findings.fact: Two public Google identities share the same physical pin: network urgent-care card has no reviews, national phone and network homepage; partner Monroe ENT card has 4.8/104, local phone and booking link.
findings.interpretation: A public identity and service-role clarification opportunity. The partner reputation is already strong.
findings.action: Confirm actual business/department identities and authority before choosing profile or naming changes; align authorized location-specific links and approved hours.

findings.fact: Queen City Monroe has 104 reviews; CornerStone Monroe 370 at the same 4.8 rating. CEENTA Monroe has 404 at 4.6 but includes eye care.
findings.interpretation: Established positive reputation with a smaller accumulated review base than these two local comparators.
cannot_claim: Review collection failure causes lost patients
A two-comparator median is a market standard
findings.action: Review public review-request routing and local proof presentation; diagnose internal request practices only after separate access.

findings.fact: First ten newest entries span 2–6 months at Queen City, 1–2 months at CornerStone, and 23 hours–5 days at CEENTA; some entries are edited.
findings.interpretation: Freshness deserves a measured follow-up; strongest visible recent activity is atCEENTA, with service-mix caveat.
findings.action: Collect original dated events for the same window and entity if a velocity comparison is required.

findings.fact: ENT Google hours differ from Queen City Google hours on Mon, Tue, Thu and Fri; Queen City Google matches the partner website.
findings.interpretation: Same-place public schedule inconsistency across brands.
findings.action: Approve a canonical location schedule and clarify any deliberate urgent-care versus practice-hours distinction before publishing corrections.

commercial_conclusion.sprint_2500_gate: Not established by Search/Reviews alone. Findings support coordinated public entity/service representation work, but simple hours and review-link fixes belong in a DIY list. Combine only with substantial verified website/social/service evidence and agreed execution rights.

commercial_conclusion.priority: Keep strong reputation visible, clarify the two identities and actual local service offer; do not sell low-rating remediation.
